name: Donald Miller’s StoryBrand Framework (SB7)
diagnostic: Can an uninformed user understand what we offer, what problem it resolves, and how to buy it within five seconds of landing on our touchpoint?
artifact: A 7-Part Grunt-Tested BrandScript: Character → Problem (External, Internal, Philosophical) → Guide (Empathy + Authority) → Plan → Call to Action → Avoided Failure → Resulting Success.
trap: Cluttering above-the-fold messaging with internal corporate milestones, history, or technical jargon rather than clarifying user progress.
pedigreeFull: Donald Miller (*Building a StoryBrand*, 2017). A narrative structure derived from classic screenwriting designed to eliminate cognitive noise in marketing.
